Each header is offered under "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"; SimOptix uses them under the MIT licence, the one
of the two that is compatible with GPL-2.0. The MIT licence text is in LICENSE.txt (from the SDK's
LICENSES/MIT.txt, with the headers' copyright line). Used to build the OpenXR layer
(vr_mirror/frame_sources/openxr/) and its check program.
